## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Evidence

List commands, revisions and captured exit codes. Mark anything not run explicitly.
For UI changes, include desktop and mobile screenshots.

## Review

- [ ] Scope and capability claims match the implementation.
- [ ] Relevant checks and limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] No secrets, generated runtime state or private worker evidence are included.
- [ ] Documentation and regression coverage were updated where applicable.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for contributor gates.
